problem.title: Network Delay Time
problem.problemStatement: Given a directed weighted network and a starting node, determine the minimum time required for a signal to reach every node. If any node cannot be reached, print -1.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N, M, and S. • Next M lines contain integers u, v, and w.
problem.output: Print the required network delay time.
